response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_invoiced_orders, AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt
